citations.quote: The SA-CCR methodology – like the CEM – treats the EAD as a combination of the CE or replacement cost (RC) and PFE
is the previously described alpha parameter with a default value of 1.4.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: How Basel turns derivatives counterparty risk into capital: EAD via CEM→SA-CCR→IMM (IMM sets EAD=α×EEPE with α=1.4; SA-CCR sets EAD=α×(RC+PFE) with an over-collateralisation multiplier), feeding the CVA capital charge (basic BA-CVA and standardised SA-CVA; the older internal-model/VaR-style charge is removed), per Gregory Ch.13.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Regulatory Counterparty Capital: SA-CCR, EAD = α×EEPE, and the CVA Capital Ladder
